title: Ibiharage
description: Ibiharage is a Burundi classic prepared with kidney beans, yellow onion, tomato, cilantro. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans or peas in plentiful cold water for 480 minutes, then drain and discard the soaking liquid; keep refrigerated in hot conditions.
Boil soaked kidney beans in fresh water vigorously for at least 10 minutes, then simmer until completely tender before combining with sauce.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 17 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
